title: pssc cov gaps --json
description: Every point of a coverage report (pssunit.coverage/1 JSON or a pssc test --cov .cdb) with 0 hits: statements and branch arms (with the source lines around them when the file is found), registers never accessed, and the value bins never seen of the registers that were. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

id.description: statement/arm: the point's stable ID `<scope>/<path>`; register: its instance path; bin: `<register>.<field>:<bin>`.

scope.description: statement/arm: the function, action coroutine or component type.

file.description: statement/arm: the source path as the model's provenance spells it.

implicit.description: arm: an else the source does not write.

context.description: Source lines around `line`; empty when the file is not found.

comp.description: register: the holding component instance; null from a .cdb, which does not keep it.
